review_type: Independent local host-bound health exclusion policy and public-package review

independent_tests.scope: Root-owned private temporary fixtures; no network probes or package/service actions
checks: Only exactly matching canonical host probes are removed; all remaining host/IP/port/path/TLS fields remain unchanged
Unknown, duplicate, wildcard, uppercase, invalid DNS-label and all-probes exclusion requests are rejected
Unsafe file modes, links, size, ownership/binding, duplicate JSON keys and parent paths are rejected
Original policy absence is bound and a later policy file cannot expand job coverage
Early and PHP-migration health paths share the bound receipt and reject policy drift before curl
A nonempty exclusion policy requires a discoverable HTTP baseline

combined_validation_observed.scope: Parent-run full regression result read from hash-bound validation manifest; eight independent checks executed separately

actual_Python36_evidence.interpreter: Canonical-authenticated CPython3.6.9 privately extracted without package installation
checks: Twelve bootstrap/helper modules compile/import, including the health policy
A host-bound temporary policy filters one exact host and rejects later receipt drift
Bionic planning, pre-Noble PHP rejection and mocked package logging remain compatible
The exact inline bootstrap/helper definitions execute with the final production call excluded; start=False installation uses only temporary paths
The delivered offline release verifier passes

findings_fixed: Invalid DNS labels previously passed the initial host regex
Inactive web service baselines previously bypassed unknown-exclusion coverage validation
preserved_controls: TLS verification and every remaining production HTTP probe
No Nginx/application configuration edits by exclusion filtering
Machine-bound root-owned0600 policy, exact approved host list and SHA256 receipt
Existing job state, units, schemas, process/admission locks and prelaunch-only code refresh protections
Ubuntu release sequencing, database compatibility-line and PHP runtime/configuration checks
limits: Excluding a hostname removes health evidence for that exact hostname; it does not verify or repair the excluded endpoint
The local root-owned policy is deployment-specific approval data and is intentionally absent from public source
Policy changes or appearance during a bound job cause a hold rather than silently widening exclusions
Unknown hosts and exclusion of every available probe are not accepted
Local fixtures and extracted Python do not establish universal live host compatibility, native APT success or tested recovery
No live release upgrade, live application migration or complete vulnerability-closure claim is made
